correctness.rationale: On connected symmetric stochastic kernels P, X=I-P+J/N is SPD and tr(X^{-1})-1 is strictly convex because its second directional derivative is positive for each nonzero symmetric direction. Therefore its unrestricted minimizer is unique and must inherit all clique and leaf permutations. Exact leaf, clique-contrast, and quotient eigenvalues reduce the Kemeny spectral sum to (r+1)/(N a)+r(N-1)/(N b)+(n-2)/(a+(n-1)c). Monotonicity in b,c forces saturation; the remaining F(z) has strictly positive second derivative, divergent endpoints and a single derivative zero. Fixed-r asymptotics and maximum-degree benchmark follow by exact substitution. The actual standalone checker passed 585 assertions, including 105 independent exact rational inverse traces. Floating checks are supplementary, not the proof.

The published multi-leaf pineapple SLEM theorem has a phase at number of leaves equal to clique nonhub size; the present Kemeny optimizer uses every clique-internal edge for every r, showing the SLEM theorem cannot simply be substituted.
Faught et al 2021 uses simple random walk degree-proportional stationary law; arbitrary symmetric design uses uniform stationary law and a different constrained domain.
claim_vs_prior_implication.reasoning: We assessed logical implication rather than matching words. Related one-leaf SLEM and all-core leaf-corona Kemeny statements do not cover the localized multi-leaf graph Kemeny optimum.

originality.rationale: Closest unrestricted stochastic design paper optimizes SLEM rather than the inverse spectral sum, and closest Kemeny design papers provide general convex frameworks, not the evaluated all-n all-r clique-star optimizer and r+1 asymptotic benchmark. Related prior exact Kemeny designs on leaf coronas place leaves at every core vertex, so their symmetry, quotient, constraints and formulas do not imply localized gateway-pendant optimality. Best-knowledge assessment does not establish priority against all unindexed results.
residual_risks: An unindexed source may solve the weighted symmetric inverse-trace objective for pineapple graphs under a different name.
The general Kemeny convex framework is strong antecedent; an evaluator could classify the scalar reduction as an immediate application rather than a distinct result.
Full text of every specialized later Kemeny graph-family publication was not exhaustively examined; priority is a best-knowledge judgment rather than certification.

value.rationale: A canonical bottleneck-plus-dense-core graph family receives a full unrestricted optimizer for all n≥3 and r≥1; every internal clique edge is strictly used unlike potential SLEM star-equivalent designs, and the maximum-degree stochastic heuristic has limiting multiplicative loss r+1 at fixed r, unbounded as r varies. The parameter r is a natural count of pendant states, not an arbitrary cut; the result is a reusable exact benchmark for mean first-passage design rather than a routine evaluation of a fixed eigenvalue list.
